meta.name: agent-credit
meta.description: Borrow from Aave via credit delegation. Agent self-funds by borrowing against delegator collateral. Supports borrow, repay, health checks. Works on Aave V2/V3.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从Aave借出资产，用信用委托自动还款
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在Aave上有抵押资产，想自动借出并管理头寸
copy.tagline_en: Borrow from Aave via credit delegation, auto-repay and manage health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have collateral on Aave and want to automate borrowing and position management

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动从 Aave 借出代币，并偿还债务。它会先检查你的健康因子和授权额度，确保安全后才执行操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 借出或偿还 Aave 上的代币时触发，例如“借 100 USDC”或“还清所有 USDC 债务”。

say.text: 从 Aave 借 100 USDC 到我的钱包。
say.note: Claude 会检查健康因子和授权，然后执行借款。

say.text: 还清我所有的 USDC 债务。
say.note: Claude 会偿还全部 USDC 债务。

say.text: 检查我的 Aave 健康因子和债务情况。
say.note: Claude 会返回当前健康因子和债务详情。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can autonomously borrow tokens from Aave using delegated credit and repay debts. It checks health factor and allowance before executing, ensuring safety.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to borrow or repay tokens on Aave, e.g., 'borrow 100 USDC' or 'repay all USDC debt'.

say_en.text: Borrow 100 USDC from Aave to my wallet.
say_en.note: Claude checks health factor and allowance, then executes the borrow.
Claude repays the full USDC debt.

say_en.text: Check my Aave health factor and debt.
say_en.note: Claude returns current health factor and debt details.
